grafcetEditor.title: The GRAFCET editor gets smarter
grafcetEditor.body: Drop or move a step, a transition, an action or a step referral next to a compatible element: the link is created for you and the element snaps into place. When you move a step or a transition, its aligned actions and step referrals follow it.

actionChains.title: Chain the actions of a step
actionChains.body: An action now has a connection point on its right: link it to the next action to build a step → action → action chain. A new action chains itself after the previous one, and a moved action takes the rest of its chain along. If you delete the step, the chain stays together: link its first action to another step to reattach everything.

scene3dDisplay.title: Show the 3D scene where you want
scene3dDisplay.body: Show the 3D scene in a panel on the right of the editors, to follow the grafcet and the operative part side by side, for example when projecting. You can also open it in a floating box that you move and resize like a window, in a page of the editor or in a browser tab. The View menu and the "3D scene" button of the status bar open the scene in the chosen mode.
